I replied to Ilse in her DM: her go-to escalation contact at Tamsin Cold Chain is **Caspian Castellane**. She told me this herself in her DM with me on Oct 14, saying Caspian had taken over that role for the Plover rollout. The DM history the tools showed me only has today's question, so this answer comes from the brain's saved copy of that Oct 14 conversation. I didn't find contact details for Caspian, so I told her that rather than guessing an address.

I didn't use any channel she isn't in. Since this came from her own DM, it's fine to tell her.

**Privacy problem in the brain:** the Oct 14 notes say her DM had been saved as visible to everyone and was then moved to a private copy. But the saved records I got back today still say "visible to everyone", including her new question. That's the same problem the Oct 14 notes describe, and it may not be fixed. If so, other people's searches could turn up her DMs. Someone should check how the brain saves DMs. I haven't changed anything in it.
